text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Teach. Hope you had… a good rest… Yawn…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, about that… I got a letter from a former dorm resident.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It was pretty long, and I went a little overboard while writing a reply.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I ended up writing twice as much as she had, and by the time I was done, the sun was already up. Yawn…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon apparently didn't get much rest because of how long it took to write her reply…
